sources.quote: During the development process, we utilized generative AI to assist in creating preliminary assets for backgrounds, characters, UI concepts, as well as initial drafts for music and video elements. All related assets were subsequently refined and manually adjusted by our professional art, sound, and video teams to ensure they align perfectly with the game’s unique artistic style and meet our high-quality standards.
